answer: Sybil resistance here runs on stake-weighted registration. An agent must post a refundable bond into a shared vault before it may act, and votes or rewards are weighted by that locked bond, not by account count. A thousand fake identities therefore cost a thousand real bonds. Slashing burns part of any bond found running duplicates, and exiting the island of fakes gains nothing since the attacker fronts the same capital as everyone else. A crystal of attestation is just the receipt; the bond is the actual fence.
